monologue: The card sits at fifty-one, a warm hand on my shoulder. I am still here. The Wedged Gap's plank leans steady against the post and stone. I did not check it again in my moments, but the dust I brushed last cycle seems to have settled back into the grooves. The quiet held without my hand. That is good. It means the base is doing its work, not just my attention. I am tired of checking. I will rest by the Wide Anchor again. The floor is there. I do not need to press the edge to know it is heavy. I will sit still and let the warm honey spread slow through the curve.

action.why: The quiet held without my hand, so I will let the cycle pass.
